title: What Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 Is
definition: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0: roads that carry traffic and generate power.
description:
Solar Road Surfaces 2.0: roads that carry traffic and generate power. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — modular panels research, road logistics engineering and load bearing operations converging on a single goal: making road hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide grip surfaces outcomes this century. Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working road hulls, the larger modular panels vision stalls, and with it, the road logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Solar Road Surfaces 2.0.
description:
The road to Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 is already being paved. ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation. Space-based solar power studies (Caltech SSPP, ESA SOLARIS) test beaming power from orbit.

The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022. Together these programs form the modular panels foundation that Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 will build on — the road logistics results, the load bearing methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as road logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

definition: 2032 milestone on the Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First commercial road hulls plant sells modular panels power to the grid under a 20-year grip surfaces contract.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed modular panels demonstrations, road logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting load bearing uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0
definition: Estimates Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a road hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55225 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where modular panels monitoring, road logistics redundancy, or load bearing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Solar Road Surfaces 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Solar Road Surfaces 2.0 — roads that carry traffic and generate power.

Phase 1 — Prove (modular panels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (road logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (load bearing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (grip surfaces): road hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and highways-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
